description: Faceted tag registry for the merged Problems list (Patterns + Applied). Each facet is either DERIVED (computed at load from an existing lesson field — no per-lesson authoring) or AUTHORED (stored on the manifest lesson entry under `tags`). Filter semantics: AND across facets, OR within a facet. Adding a company = append a value to the `company` facet here; no code change. See iter-artifacts/navigation-refactor-design.md § Tags & faceted filtering.

facets.label: Type
facets.note: Recovers the pre-merge Patterns/Applied split as a filter. Computed from lesson.track.

facets.label: Topic
facets.note: Values are the section names of the patterns+applied tracks, computed at load from the manifest — section IS the topic. Not enumerated here to avoid drift.

facets.label: Company
facets.note: Multi-valued. Seeded empty — populate manifest lesson entries' tags.company[] over time. Add a company by appending a value here.
